description: Two sensors. SessionStart announces what the SCW layer has loaded. The gate hooks intercept every tool call, attribute it to the bound SCW role that made it, and record it -- refusing out-of-scope calls when the gate is in enforce mode. The gate is what makes a delegated agent's own actions observable at all: the runtime records what the host does to the window, and an agent dispatched as a subagent works in a context the window has no address for. Default mode is observe, so installing the plugin records but blocks nothing until a policy is declared and enforce is set.
